$description: Rekta Design's public hooks: --rk- custom properties that are not tokens. A page, a native shell or rekta.js writes them; rekta.css reads them. build.mjs ships them as `hooks` in rekta.tokens.json and --check holds docs/behaviour.md (Public hooks) to this list.

v.readBy: A meter's value, 0 to 1; a share of a .rk-shares bar, in any unit.

titlebar-controls.readBy: Room kept at the title bar's end for the window's own buttons (140px by default) when data-rk-titlebar shows it.

sec-w.readBy: A panorama section's width when sideways.

split-w.readBy: The width of a split's list pane; the handle writes it while dragged.

banner-h.readBy: scroll-padding, the sticky strip, toasts without anchor positioning.

pivot-h.readBy: scroll-padding under a sticky section strip.

toast-left.readBy: What is left of a toast's undo window, 1 to 0: the countdown line along the toast's foot.

scrollbar.readBy: The root's right padding while a sheet is open: the scrollbar's room, so nothing behind shifts.

stage-top.readBy: Where a wide facet row starts below the fixed chrome and the place's title block; the row fills the height under it.

series-1.readBy: A domain colour code, 1 to 8, per theme (docs/data.md).
